description: Electrical apparatus; photosensitive semiconductor devices n.e.c. in heading no. 8541, including photovoltaic cells, whether or not assembled in modules or made up into panels

retired.note: HS 2022 replaced 8541.50 with 8541.51 (semiconductor-based transducers) and 8541.59 (other semiconductor devices). The WCO correlation tables give the new subheadings only a general counterpart spanning Chapters 84, 85, 90, 93 and 95, so no exact mapping is asserted here.

lineage.familyNote: These codes together cover this product across the HS 2022 revision. They do not overlap in time, so stacking them gives a continuous series without apportioning anything.

coverage.retired: Withdrawn from the Harmonized System after 2021. Rows still filed under this number are residuals, not a world total, so no figure is published.
